operation_details.item: The user uses cost-plus pricing for one product line.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How’s the pricing work going today?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: It’s moving along well. I’m reviewing the approaches across our offerings so the team stays consistent in client conversations.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: What approaches are you using across the different products?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I use value-based pricing for the platform, competitor-based pricing for the entry tier, and cost-plus pricing for one product line.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That sounds deliberately segmented rather than one-size-fits-all. How are you keeping everyone aligned?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The pricing approaches are documented in the pricing guide, so sales and leadership can reference the same rationale.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That should make deal reviews much smoother, especially when the team is balancing revenue goals with client value.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Exactly. It gives us a clear framework while still leaving room for thoughtful client discussions.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Forget only that I use cost-plus pricing, while keeping the value-based and competitor-based approaches and the guide.
